rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.05, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-6 INIT_T limit probe, breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: init_t@relax1.0: 0.7->PSNR16.5, 0.4->19.4, 0.2->22.0, 0.1->25.2 (RMSE 1.88e-2). MONOTONIC toward baseline PSNR36.3/RMSE5.21e-3 as init_t->0. hr=0 throughout. (2) FAILURE MODE: the wavelet prior injects net-harmful structure; the recon improves as prior influence shrinks. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.1 -> 0.05 (near prior-off; recon ~ light-denoised FBP + full CG-DC). (4) HYPOTHESIS: continues the trend; establishes the init_t->0 asymptote (does DC-anchored near-FBP clear the baseline, or is even the CG-DC-projected FBP below the plain Hann FBP baseline?). This localizes whether ANY init_t can clear hr>0. FALSIFIER: if PSNR plateaus below 36 as init_t->0, the DC-on wavelet recon is structurally FBP-bounded on sparse breast (the CG-DC/prior chain never beats the plain FBP baseline) -> spend remaining iters confirming via steps/n_cg then conclude. (5) BUDGET ~90s. (6) iter-7 on landing.
